## Description

Import services and prices from CSV/XLSX with a validation preview (codes, tax, duplicates), dry run, then commit as price versions effective from a date.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Invalid rows are reported with reasons and nothing is committed until the preview is approved.
- [ ] **AC2.** Import is idempotent by service code and records who imported.
- [ ] **AC3.** Template files for India and UAE are provided.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
